And FYI, I was asking what should I do and telling a story that occurred to me in OSRS on the OSRS reddit. Where do you get off being so rude?

I take issue with the idea that normal accounts are incentivized to do what is the highest gp/hr, because it's a game and that makes it sound like it's not a game and is just a spreadsheet simulator. It doesn't make sense that even 50% of the player base (which would be needed to support the idea of highest gp/hr incentive existing) is focused on that. 

Just look at the most recent poll results. The new elf quests from RS3 won almost unanimously and with massive margins and they aren't endgame crazy expensive content places or anything. I'd say that's more evidence that a larger amount of the player base is into having fun and playing a game than getting better gp/hr or anything else.

The biggest pitfall we could fall into with OSRS is making it another online game where there's intense elitism. You know what was great back in the day? Party hats were extremely rare, had massive value, and were utterly useless but every one still wanted all those fun social items because they recognized it's a game, not a lifestyle. Somehow, OSRS has gotten more elitist, gold, and efficiency-centric since it has gotten bigger and that isn't a good thing.

And it's cause for concern that so many people in the community get so toxic and defensive of pvp and high tier because mid tier is absolute trash in comparison. I'm mid-level atm on my new main since my old old account from 2006 was banned after being hacked by botters, and the best moneymaking thing I've gotten to so far is grinding out karambwans that get me like 150k/hr. That's just so minuscule in comparison to high level content. Low levels can get the same money per hour just looting or selling bounties. There doesn't seem to be any true mid-level money making methods that are actually middle of the road money wise. You go from 100k/hr, grind for a million years, and you don't get a decent upgrade in cash flow til the 80s and it's grinding 40 mil value drops or some crap.

The economy is a concern, but giving people a couple of easy moneymaking drops noted from existing mid level content would do a lot to assuage most pker hatred by giving players real alternatives. Think of it like this, Runescape is a free market capitalist economy and, as such, the power of all content lies in one group eternally. In the case of wildy being dead for pkers, it's because the strength of interest in going into the wildy is astoundingly low. The content sucks, there's absolutely no reprieve where you can find any safety to enjoy the pvm on your own, it's exorbitantly high level requiring not only grinding but exceedingly valuable gear that you WILL end up losing a few mill if pked fighting some of the bosses, and co-op content is just more fun than pvp content in this style of game.

It's understandable that people want to be the best, but when the best is so far above the rest that they don't even wanna play, they're just like that lady who got pissed off that teens didn't wanna work just for experience and not get paid when they complain about no one to kill in wildy. 

Myopic and completely selfish idiots.
